# Iron Horse Restorations (unofficial concept page by Kerblabs)

> Classic car restoration shop in Cantonment, Florida. Tagline on the shop's site: "Restoring Classic Cars in Cantonment, FL, Since 2004".

Source of facts: ironhorserestorations.com and public listings. This is a design concept, not the shop's official site.

## Services
- Full restoration
- Paint and bodywork, auto body repair
- Custom upholstery
- Engine rebuild and performance work
- Custom exhaust systems
- Auto glass replacement

- Hours: Mon-Fri 9 AM-5 PM; closed Saturday and Sunday

## Reputation
- The shop's site shows five-star customer reviews. No review count is published there.
